16-DI PNP sink input ioThinx 45MR slot module. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address (slot base assigned dynamically by ioThinx 4510 chassis). Only ch0-3 support event counter mode; ch4-15 are DI-only. FC01: diCounterStatus ch0-3 (0=Pause 1=Run), diCounterOverflowFlagClear ch0-3 (W=1 to clear). FC02: diStatus ch0-15, diMode ch0-15 (0=DI 1=Counter), diCounterOverflowFlag ch0-3. FC03: diCounterValue ch0-3 u64 4-words/ch (rel 0-15), diCounterStatusAll bitmask (rel 16), diCounterOverflowFlagClearAll (rel 17). FC04: diStatusAll (1 WORD), diCounterOverflowFlagAll (1 WORD), diModeAll (1 WORD).

16-DI NPN source input ioThinx 45MR slot module. Register map identical to 45MR-1600; differs only in input polarity. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address (slot base assigned dynamically by ioThinx 4510 chassis). Only ch0-3 support event counter mode; ch4-15 are DI-only. FC01: diCounterStatus ch0-3, diCounterOverflowFlagClear ch0-3. FC02: diStatus ch0-15, diMode ch0-15, diCounterOverflowFlag ch0-3. FC03: diCounterValue ch0-3 u64 (rel 0-15), diCounterStatusAll (rel 16), diCounterOverflowFlagClearAll (rel 17). FC04: diStatusAll, diCounterOverflowFlagAll, diModeAll.

4-relay output ioThinx 45MR slot module. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address. FC01: relayStatus ch0-3 (0=OFF 1=ON), relayCurrentCountReset ch0-3 (W=1 to reset). FC03: relayStatusAll bitmask (rel 0). FC04: relayTotalCount ch0-3 u64 4-words/ch (16 regs), relayCurrentCount ch0-3 u64 4-words/ch (16 regs). Total and current relay cycle counts are 64-bit (4 u16 registers per channel).

16-DO sink (NPN) output ioThinx 45MR slot module. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address. Only ch0-3 support pulse output mode; ch4-15 are DO-only. FC01: doStatus ch0-15 (0=OFF 1=ON), doPulseStatus ch0-3 (0=Stop 1=Start). FC02: doMode ch0-15 (0=DO 1=Pulse). FC03: doStatusAll bitmask (rel 0), doPulseCount ch0-3 u64 4-words/ch (rel 1-16), doPulseOnWidth ch0-3 (rel 17-20, unit 500us), doPulseOffWidth ch0-3 (rel 21-24, unit 500us), doPulseStatusAll bitmask (rel 25). FC04: doModeAll (1 WORD).

16-DO source (PNP) output ioThinx 45MR slot module. Register map identical to 45MR-2600; differs only in output polarity. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address. Only ch0-3 support pulse output mode. FC01: doStatus ch0-15, doPulseStatus ch0-3. FC02: doMode ch0-15. FC03: doStatusAll bitmask (rel 0), doPulseCount ch0-3 u64 (rel 1-16), doPulseOnWidth ch0-3 (rel 17-20, unit 500us), doPulseOffWidth ch0-3 (rel 21-24, unit 500us), doPulseStatusAll bitmask (rel 25). FC04: doModeAll.

8-DI + 8-DO mixed I/O ioThinx 45MR slot module. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address. FC02: diStatus ch0-7, diMode ch0-7 (0=DI 1=Counter), doMode ch0-7 (0=DO 1=Pulse), diCounterOverflowFlag ch0-1. FC03: diCounterValue ch0-1 u64 (rel 0-7), doStatusAll (rel 8), doPulseCount ch0-1 u64 (rel 9-16), doPulseOnWidth ch0-1 (rel 17-18, unit 500us), doPulseOffWidth ch0-1 (rel 19-20, unit 500us), doPulseStatusAll (rel 21), diCounterStatusAll (rel 22), diCounterOverflowFlagClearAll (rel 23). FC04: diStatusAll, diCounterOverflowFlagAll, diModeAll, doModeAll.

8-AI current-input (0-20mA/4-20mA) ioThinx 45MR slot module. Addresses are module-relative; actual PDU address = slot_base + relative_address.
